title: feat: add Polli visual studio and tool complexity routing
author: Itachi-1824
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds Visual Studio rendering with complexity-based model selection and full-page image capture.
- Packages the Discord bot and API with a separate networkless rendering worker, persistent data, and loopback-only API exposure.
- Adds opt-in container deployment with health checks, prior-release rollback, and deployment-lock safeguards.
- Manually deployed d22a26009 on production: both containers healthy, Discord connected to two guilds, API healthy, and real isolated rendering verified.
- Preserves the old installation and pre-cutover data backup for rollback; container autodeploy is enabled for the upcoming merge. PR left unmerged.

gist.headline: Polli Opens the Studio
gist.blurb: Polli can now render a Visual Studio workspace into a full-page image, choosing an appropriately capable model based on the task’s complexity. The tiny bee has acquired a design desk and, somehow, a separate rendering bunker.
gist.summary: Added Polli Visual Studio rendering with complexity-based model routing and full-page image capture, alongside an isolated networkless rendering worker and container deployment path with health checks and rollback safeguards.
gist.impact: Discord communities using Polli can request richer Visual Studio renders while the bot selects models by task complexity and keeps page rendering isolated from its public API service.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli’s new Visual Studio as a cozy garden-shed design workspace: Polli, wearing a tiny painter’s beret, directs a retro CRT rendering station that captures a long illustrated webpage as a glowing scroll. A small Monitor Robot eagerly holds the finished full-page printout, while a separate little sealed render-room glows safely in the background; code-plants and flowers make the routing and isolated-worker theme feel warm rather than industrial.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of the pollinations bee mascot in a tiny painter’s beret at a garden-shed Visual Studio, choosing between small and large glowing model cards while a retro CRT captures a long full-page artwork scroll; the bee has a yellow body with dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings. A cute chunky Monitor Robot holds the finished render beside a small safely enclosed worker room, with code-plants, flowers, and vines around soft lime green (#ecf874) screens; simple pixel text reads “FULL PAGE.” Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
